column1: # The Ruby identifier-rules corpus (docs/PORT-RUBY.md, IDENTIFIERS): one schema
# beside this file per case, each loaded as the file Game.schema through the
# parser and the shared checker, then held to the Ruby name check
#   ruby: the shared checker passes it and the Ruby check refuses it, naming
#     the member the field or arm would replace;
#   checker: the shared checker already refuses it for every target (a table
#     field whose Dart spelling is a Dart table verb, docs/SPEC-TABLES.md §11),
#     so no Ruby unit ever holds it;
#   accepted: the lawful control beside the refusals.
# says: what the refusal names ("-" for an accepted case).
# A field spelled like a member every generated class defines or relies on.

column3: Player's field to_h is the name of a member the generated class defines
Player's field public_send is the name of a member the generated class defines

column1: # A union arm spelled like a member of the union class, or whose tag constant

column3: union Event's arm public_send is the name of a member the generated union class defines
union Event's arm NAMES spells the constant EventType::NAMES

column1: # A table field spelled like a member only a table class defines.

column3: Fleet's field save_text is the name of a member the generated table class defines
Fleet's field cook is the name of a member the generated table class defines
Fleet's field cook_measure is the name of a member the generated table class defines
Fleet's field save_text is the name of a member the generated table class defines
Fleet's field cook_measure is the name of a member the generated table class defines

column1: # The table-class members whose Dart spellings (measure, measureRetain,
# saveRetain, toJson) are Dart table verbs: refused before any backend.

column3: field measure collides with the generated Dart table verb `measure`
field measure_retain collides with the generated Dart table verb `measureRetain`
field save_retain collides with the generated Dart table verb `saveRetain`
field to_json collides with the generated Dart table verb `toJson`
